name: Folding Amplifier
description: Nonlinear waveshaper that folds signal back on itself when exceeding thresholds

behavior.summary: Instead of clipping when signal exceeds bounds, the signal 'folds' back creating triangle-wave-like response
behavior.visual_effect: Bright areas wrap to dark, creates banding/contouring effects
behavior.audio_analog: Similar to wavefolder in audio synthesis - adds harmonics through folding

transfer_function.soft_fold: Uses tanh or sine for rounded fold corners

parameters.gain: Amplification before folding (controls number of folds)

paik_abe.description: Discrete transistor folding using differential pairs
